entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This gate is shut... It appears as though[n]we cannot force it open.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Think we need a card for this too?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: There's no keycard device though.[n]Perhaps it's on the other side?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oooh, maybe we can open this up with[n]a keycard too?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: There are bars here... We won't be able[n]to open the door like this.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It seems we may be able to pass if we[n]have a particular item though...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Think it's time to pop out that keycard[n]from earlier?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Tch, we ain't gonna get in like this...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But look. It says, "No entry by[n]unauthorized personnel."

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That just makes me want to go in more![n]Isn't there anything we can do?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, there's no point going to that[n]reception room anymore. Come on,[n]let's check somewhere else.
